id: title:dmarchuk:stop re querying postgres for known invalid push tokens

review.posthog_relevance: Replaces Redis-backed or unbounded caching for invalid token fingerprints with an in-process, size-bounded TTL cache, reducing shared-cache poisoning risk and Redis dependency.
review.reason: Adds threading and TTLCache imports, defines an in-process, size-bounded cache and a lock to protect it, establishes a fixed-size, short-TTL cache for invalid token fingerprints, and replaces a Redis-backed or unbounded lookup pattern.
review.uncertainty: The exact implementation and relevant checks are not fully visible; the tier is assigned based on the observed behavior and its connection to PostHog, not on unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are inferred. No tier assignment is performed.

observations.behavior: Adds threading and TTLCache imports, then defines an in-process, size-bounded cache and a lock to protect it.
observations.posthog_connection: Push subscription endpoint shared state protection; prevents unbounded Redis key growth and shared-cache poisoning by keeping the cache in-process and bounded.
